text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm Kitasan Black!
It's great to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become someone who can
bring energy and cheer to everyone, just like my dad!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will do my best and forge straight ahead,
so I look forward to your continued guidance and support!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
